Name: PotPlayer Dial Control
Author: Desmond Harris

Actions.Name: Counter
Actions.Tooltip: Displays a count, which increments by one on press.

Actions.Name: Dial Control
Actions.Tooltip: Control PotPlayer directly in the background from a single dial, with live volume and playback progress on screen

TriggerDescription.Rotate: Rotate left/right (hold the dial in while rotating for the alt action)
TriggerDescription.Push: Press / hold / double-press for three different actions
TriggerDescription.Touch: Tap or hold the screen for two more actions

Description: Control PotPlayer directly in the background from the Stream Deck dial, with live volume and playback progress on screen
